import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Dataset with high-cardinality categorical variable
data = {
    'city': ['NYC', 'LA', 'Chicago', 'NYC', 'LA', 'Houston', 'NYC', 'Chicago', 'LA', 'Houston',
             'NYC', 'LA', 'Chicago', 'Houston', 'NYC'],
    'sales': [500, 300, 200, 550, 350, 150, 480, 220, 320, 180, 520, 280, 210, 160, 490]
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Calculate the mean sales for each city (target encoding)
mean_sales = df.groupby('city')['sales'].mean()

# Apply smoothing to avoid overfitting
global_mean = df['sales'].mean()
m = 10  # smoothing parameter
counts = df.groupby('city')['sales'].count()
smoothed = (counts * mean_sales + m * global_mean) / (counts + m)

# Map the smoothed values back to the original dataframe
df['city_encoded'] = df['city'].map(smoothed)

# Print the dataframe with target-encoded city column
print("Mean sales by city:")
print(mean_sales.round(2))
print("\nSmoothed target encoding:")
print(smoothed.round(2))
print("\nEncoded DataFrame:")
print(df)
